title: Clade support comparison (mock)
goal: Mock dataset (not empirical or user data). Read support at internal ancestors while distinguishing two named sample groups.

rubric.must: A/B and D/E are sister pairs nested in their respective three-tip groups.
Support values 99, 88, 74 and 96 are legible and associated with the correct internal nodes.
The North and South sample groups are distinguishable without hiding labels or branches.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the phylo/slanted exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows both named groups as distinct colored clade panels, with labels and branches visible. The topology and all four support values match the source data; labels and connections are readable without material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: Samples A and B join as a sister pair within North, alongside C. Samples D and E join as a sister pair within South, alongside F.
The internal nodes show 99 for the A/B pair, 88 for the North three-tip group, 74 for the D/E pair, and 96 for the South three-tip group.
North and South are distinguished by teal and blue branches, brackets, labels, and lightly shaded panels. Sample labels and branch connections remain visible.
